From Zero to Building Real Models — In Public

LATEST SEEDED ENTRY · Lab Notes · Entry #01 ✓ Lab & Excalidraw Figures Live

What an LLM actually is

“What is the model really doing when it answers you?”

An LLM does not look up answers or plan sentences; it scores every possible next piece of text, picks one, appends it to your prompt, and forgets it ever ran.

The Turn: “I used to treat LLM hallucinations like mystifying bugs in a reasoning brain; writing the 40-line next-token loop showed me how often I too commit to an impulsive first sentence and spend the next five minutes defending it.”
